name: Artificial Intelligence for Smart Power Systems
description: Smart power system fundamentals, challenges, and opportunities in smart grids; artificial intelligence methods (fuzzy logic, neural networks, machine learning, deep learning, evolutionary algorithms); AI techniques for voltage and frequency control and reactive power management; adaptive protection systems (relay coordination, fault detection, phase identification); machine learning and deep learning for event detection and classification; AI for power system security and stability assessment; optimal device placement (DGs, FACTS, capacitors, PMUs); intelligent systems for load forecasting and renewable energy prediction; and cybersecurity in smart grid with AI-based solutions
